params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-heaven-v2-clean-install'; if(Test-Path $tmp){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -Force}; git clone --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $tmp; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw ('git clone failed: '+$LASTEXITCODE)}; $src=Join-Path $tmp 'heaven-bridge\install-github-runner.ps1'; $runnerDir=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'actions-runner-heaven-v2'; & $src -Repository 'fengie/mhw-mods' -RunnerName 'heaven-v2' -RunnerDirectory $runnerDir -Labels @('heaven-v2','local-bridge','mhw-mods'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw ('runner installer failed: '+$LASTEXITCODE)}
